name: omp
promptNotes: Oh My Pi backgrounds a foreground shell command only after 60 s, and a Stagecraft dispatch has a 10-minute ceiling. Never start a server, file watcher, or REPL in the foreground. Start it with the bash tool's `async: true` (or `cmd > /dev/null 2>&1 &`), probe it with curl, and stop it when you are done — each foreground server start would otherwise cost this dispatch a full minute.
Single tool calls are capped at 120 s by `.devteam/omp/dispatch.yml` (installed by `devteam init --host omp`). A test suite that needs longer should be run in pieces.
